evidence_status: Development only; all May 16-23 dates were previously exposed.
sources: The 32 complete, official-checksum-verified BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT Binance USD-M bookTicker and aggTrades daily ZIP files already cached for May 16-23, 2023.
acquisition: No new dates or downloads. Expand extraction to all available hours of the existing daily files.
label: Unchanged five-second three-class label: entry is first quote at or after decision+100ms, future is first quote at or after decision+5100ms, neutral threshold max(half entry spread, one tick).
observations: Nonempty, completed one-second quote buckets only. Decision features use events strictly before bucket close. Verify chronological update IDs and nondecreasing event times. No label-dependent eligibility filtering.
data_contract: Dedicated forecast-only dataset. Reproduce the existing observed fields and exact labels; do not claim maker-fill, execution-path, or L2 fields that are not computed.
new_features: Raw OFI and quote counts during the final 50 and 200 milliseconds of each completed bucket
Price returns since the last observable quote at or before decision minus 50/200 milliseconds
Event-weighted mean and standard deviation of queue imbalance within the bucket
Counts and signed counts of within-bucket midprice changes; absolute event-return variation
Positive and negative raw OFI magnitudes, each normalized by ending displayed depth
Age of the most recent best-bid and best-ask price change, measured at the decision
Signed trade volume and total trade volume in the final 50/200 milliseconds, normalized by ending displayed depth
verification: Before fitting, compare common decision-time fields and exact labels against the canonical previously generated noon slices after at least 120 seconds of warmup; test controlled synthetic paths and prefix causality.
development_splits: Same four training dates, one validation date, one assessment date as earlier screens. Train-window ablation uses noon only versus all available past hours. Validation and assessment remain the frozen noon window.
eligibility: Require common contiguous one-second coverage of both assets; discard the first 120 seconds of each continuous run and the last 60 seconds of each UTC day. Quote-age limit 1000ms. Selection uses decision-time information only.
next_fit_registration: Freeze exact representations, learner grid and selection procedure after preprocessing parity checks and before any fitting on the expanded data.
reserved: May 24 onward remain unopened for a separately registered confirmation experiment.
